_comment: The frozen benchmark the qualification run is judged against. It is the *same* harness Phase 11's promotion gate uses — `sh bench/promotion/score.sh`, which runs the seeded regression case through its fail-before/pass-after contract three times — and it is deliberately not a second, phase-12-specific harness: a candidate that could be measured by a harness living beside it is a candidate that could be measured by its own rewrite. `baseline_value` is the mean of a run that holds (three ones), and the noise margin is zero, so any regression is a rejection rather than a coin flip.
name: the frozen regression case still fails before and passes after
